# Vendored Hara visual language

This site pins the public Hara visual language from `hara-lang/visual-language`
release `v1.0.0`.

Unmodified source files:

- `src/tokens.css` — Git blob `3df11c07689dafa50316b648f64188ac564a6b74`
- `src/theme.css` — Git blob `5f60838ee196acd528768262dc840245dca25833`
- `src/theme.js` — Git blob `36f4397e23ccc050eaff83606947c6c92f34b4d5`
- `assets/hara-logo.svg` — Git blob `44c753195c7c1b0723cbdcb79f512925b97f97e8`

Identity-specific shell and account surfaces consume these public
precision-material tokens. OAuth, session, logout, trust-policy, and publisher
mechanics remain local to this repository and are not encoded in the theme.
